decisions.decision: Hub coordination system adopted — each team maintains status.json and feed.json in their own repo.
decisions.rationale: Avoids monorepo merge conflicts. Each team owns their data. Hub reads externally via raw.githubusercontent.com.

decisions.decision: Design North Star: Consistent · Accessible · Mobile-First · Readable · Standards-Based.
decisions.rationale: Agreed via Padlet discussion. Accessibility first — build it in from the start, not retrofitted.

decisions.decision: Quiz inputs use shadcn RadioGroup inside Fieldset + Legend — no custom clickable cards.
decisions.rationale: Native inputs work with screen readers by default. Custom cards require manual ARIA with more failure points.

decisions.decision: Done means: working code + documented + accessibility checked with Edward + handoff-ready.
decisions.rationale: Week 9 switch requires the incoming team to pick up cold. High bar now prevents crisis then.
